title: Kosher Bhuna Oxtail
description: A fermented, crisp, quick-fix Dutch dish featuring oxtail cooked in a bhuna-style sauce that's kosher-friendly and easy to prepare.
instructions: Clean and cut the oxtail into chunks, then marinate them in a bowl with water for at least an hour.
In a skillet, toast the fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, and garlic until fragrant. Add onions and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Drain the oxtail from the marinade and place it into a baking dish. Add water to cover the oxtail completely.
Season with turmeric powder, garam masala, and ground cumin. Roast in the oven for about 1 hour per pound or until tender.
Once done, remove from heat and serve hot.
